INSERT INTO RESERVATION ( ID, CODE, GUEST_ID, ROOM_TYPE_ID, ROOM_ID, CHECKIN, CHECKOUT, GUEST_COUNT, STATUS, ROOM_AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_METHOD, REQUEST, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{id}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || LPAD( (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM RESERVATION WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)), 2, '0' ), #{guestId}, #{roomTypeId}, #{roomId}, #{checkin}, #{checkout}, #{guestCount}, #{status}, #{roomAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{request}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT RES.ID AS reservationId, RES.CODE AS code, RES.STATUS AS status, C.NAME AS guestName, C.PHONE AS guestPhone, RT.NAME AS typeName, R.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, RES.CHECKIN AS checkin, RES.CHECKOUT AS checkout, RES.GUEST_COUNT AS guestCount, RES.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount FROM RESERVATION RES JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.ID = RES.GUEST_ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON RT.ID = RES.ROOM_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON R.ID = RES.ROOM_ID
AND (C.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR RES.CODE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND RES.STATUS = #{status}
AND TRUNC(RES.CHECKIN) = TO_DATE(#{checkinDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY RES.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT RES.ID AS reservationId, RES.CODE AS code, RES.STATUS AS status, C.NAME AS guestName, C.PHONE AS guestPhone, RT.NAME AS typeName, R.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, RES.CHECKIN AS checkin, RES.CHECKOUT AS checkout, RES.GUEST_COUNT AS guestCount, RES.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount FROM RESERVATION RES JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.ID = RES.GUEST_ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON RT.ID = RES.ROOM_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON R.ID = RES.ROOM_ID WHERE RES.GUEST_ID = #{guestId} ORDER BY RES.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT RES.ID AS reservationId, RES.CODE AS code, RES.STATUS AS status, C.NAME AS guestName, C.PHONE AS guestPhone, RT.NAME AS typeName, R.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, RES.CHECKIN AS checkin, RES.CHECKOUT AS checkout, RES.GUEST_COUNT AS guestCount, RES.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount FROM RESERVATION RES JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.ID = RES.GUEST_ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON RT.ID = RES.ROOM_TYPE_ID LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON R.ID = RES.ROOM_ID WHERE RES.ID = #{id}

SELECT RT.ID AS typeId, RT.NAME AS typeName, RT.DESCRIPTION AS description, RT.CAPACITY AS capacity, RT.MAX_CAPACITY AS maxCapacity, RT.PRICE AS price, RT.MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, RT.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, CASE WHEN RT.MAX_CAPACITY < #{guestCount} THEN 0 ELSE ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM R WHERE R.TYPE_ID = RT.ID) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION RES WHERE RES.ROOM_TYPE_ID = RT.ID AND RES.STATUS != '예약취소' AND RES.CHECKIN < TO_DATE(#{checkoutDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND RES.CHECKOUT > TO_DATE(#{checkinDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) END AS availableRoomCount FROM ROOM_TYPE RT ORDER BY RT.PRICE

SELECT RT.ID AS typeId, RT.NAME AS typeName, RT.DESCRIPTION AS description, RT.CAPACITY AS capacity, RT.MAX_CAPACITY AS maxCapacity, RT.PRICE AS price, RT.MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, RT.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl FROM ROOM_TYPE RT WHERE RT.ID = #{roomTypeId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE TYPE_ID = #{roomTypeId}) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION WHERE ROOM_TYPE_ID = #{roomTypeId} AND STATUS != '예약취소' AND CHECKIN < TO_DATE(#{checkoutDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND CHECKOUT > TO_DATE(#{checkinDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) FROM DUAL
